decisions.why: Sparkfree Fridges/Freezers and the ATEX and Advanced Laboratory ranges are laboratory refrigeration equipment, the equipment counterpart to this supplier's already-mapped Pharmacy Refrigeration division

blood bank refrigerators, plasma freezers and platelet incubators are laboratory/blood-bank equipment; no dedicated blood-bank-storage type exists so this is the closest fit, paralleling the lab equipment used for Laboratory Refrigeration
Labcold Wireless Monitoring System and Data Loggers are temperature sensors/probes monitoring cold-chain storage
the single example, Labcold Breast Milk Fridges, is dedicated breast-milk storage equipment, matching breastfeeding & milk handling
